text:
maria: FYI NimbusOpen submitted a request: marketplace listing + SI-ready on-prem bundle. need quick sync on redistribution + announcement cadence.

ajay: key legal asks in their draft: host and commercial use ok, no raw weights resale, allow distributing quantized artifacts to "certified integrators". need precise wording.

maria: can procurement define Certified SI?

luca: tech note: 13B model + 4-bit quant. we can host API, but distributing quant weights to SI requires signed delivery and KMS policy. also include perf note that some A100 kernels slower w/out fused ops.

sofia: GTM wants two-phase rollout: listing -> SI case study -> joint press. partner requests 48h asset window and 24h embargo.

reza: ops: SI bundle will be docker + manifest. require hash + KMS-signed manifest. stub: `image: redwood/nimbus:si-quant4` and `manifest: s3://partners/nimbus/manifest.json`.

ajay: propose redistribution clause: Provider grants Redwood non-exclusive right to host and distribute model and quantized artifacts, and to sublicense quantized artifacts to Redwood-certified SIs for deployment, provided SIs sign agreements prohibiting resale.

maria: procurement/legal to review indemnity caps and export controls (APAC).

sofia: timeline proposal: day -2 embargo preview, day 0 listing live (no press), day 14 SI case study, day 21 joint press. CloudPartner wants assets 48h prior.

marketplace-bot: uploaded listing draft to CI: https://ci.redwood/3723456789/artifacts :white_check_mark:

reza: action items: (1) ajay draft final clause EOD, (2) reza upload manifest + docker by tomorrow, (3) sofia notify CloudPartner of 48h prep, (4) maria start export review.

maria: i'll send summary to NimbusOpen after legal ok. thanks.
